kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَتَلَ • (šatala) I (non-past يَشْتِلُ (yaštilu), verbal noun شَتْل (šatl))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb of شَتْلَة (šatla), or also from Aramaic שׁתל / ܫܬܱܠ (štal, “to plant”).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَتَّلَ • (šattala) II (non-past يُشَتِّلُ (yušattilu), verbal noun تَشْتِيل (taštīl))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb of شَتْلَة (šatla), or also from Aramaic שׁתל / ܫܬܱܠ (štal, “to plant”).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَتْل • (šatl) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb of شَتْلَة (šatla), or also from Aramaic שׁתל / ܫܬܱܠ (štal, “to plant”).
g: verbal noun of شَتَلَ (šatala) (form I): planting, setting up a sapling

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَتْلَة • (šatla) f (plural شَتَلات (šatalāt) or شُتُول (šutūl) or شَتَائِل (šatāʔil) or شَتْل (šatl))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Aramaic שִתלָא (šiṯlā) / ܫܷܬܠܴܐ (šeṯlā), ܫܷܬܷܠܬܴܐ (šeṯelṯā), ܫܬܷܠܬܴܐ (šəṯelṯā, “plant offshoot”), from Akkadian [script needed] (šitlum). Also from Semitic: Armenian շիթիլ (šitʻil), Turkish şitil, Azerbaijani şitil.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مَشْتَل • (maštal) m (plural مَشَاتِل (mašātil))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Noun of place from the root ش ت ل (š t l).
g: a store specializing in selling plants and plant products
